first_strike._comment: D288, D300: a fight opened by a first strike (area_scene.gd winds it up out of the band's sight). As the fight opens the lead's own swing lands on the nearest foe at power times its weight, before the other side moves; the rest is an ambush (passives.ambush_head_start).
first_strike.line: {name} strikes first: {foe} never saw it coming.

rules._comment_flee: D319 (Ewan, D118: 'an open fight you can walk out of'; issue #243: 'at a cost'). Getting clear of a fight costs: whoever reaches the edge takes a parting blow of flee.parting_blow of their health as they go, never a fall (cleared_line, {who}); when the whole company gets clear of a band of the land, the band keeps flee.gold_share of the company's coin, dropped in the running (dropped_line, {coin}); the order to the edge says so (making_line). A fight left inside a gate or the Tower keeps no coin. Inferred: the tenth and the tenth.

flee.making_line: Making for the edge of the field. Whatever is dropped in the running stays dropped.
flee.cleared_line: {who} gets clear, with a parting blow for it.
flee.dropped_line: You get clear of them, {coin} the lighter for what was dropped in the running. They are still out there.

rules._comment_heal: A mend grows with its caster's level (D284): health grows every level and a spell's power did not, so Vesta's Mend (16) was a tenth of Juno at level 1 and a thirtieth at 17. From heal_from_level it heals heal_per_level more a level (level 17: 2.4 times); below it, as it was. Draughts already grow by kind and regen by share of health. Inferred: both numbers.

plan_table._comment: D298, docs/investigation/12: the plan EmbeddingGemma 2 put nearest each situation the brain can be in (SkirmishBrain.situation), written offline by tools/plan_table.py. Used only when side names one (party, foes, all); empty, play is unchanged.

tactics._comment: How every fighter moves and picks its foe besides walking up and swinging (D187, all Inferred). Every side thinks with these: enemies, allies, the party fighting on its own, Auto, and both leads in a who-wins bout. A fighter's doctrine comes from its lead (leads), else its enemy role (roles), else brute. moves are tried in order each think; focus says whom it would rather hit: hurt (a foe low on health), marked (a foe Iris has marked) and soft (a foe that heals or shoots), each worth that many tiles of walking. The player's party keeps together round its lead (D281, keep_together): with the lead under rally_below of their health and a foe on them, a companion within rally_reach tiles comes to stand between them (every rally_every seconds); no fall-back move (kite, hang back, break off) takes one of the party further than keep_with tiles from every friend still standing, and nobody hangs back from a foe already at their elbow hitting them.

stances._comment: The player's half of the tactics (D195, Inferred): a stance on each party card says which of a fighter's doctrine moves it tries first (first) and which it leaves alone (drop); the rest of its doctrine follows in its own order. No number changes. seek: goes and finds the fight, as Auto does, rather than waiting for foes within the party's reach. hold: keeps this ground and fights only what comes into reach. Enemies, Auto and the who-wins bouts always fight their own way. In the order a click on the card steps through them.

close.tip: Goes in after the foe and stays on them; no falling back.

away.tip: Keeps a gap while friends are fighting; a bow or a spell keeps shooting.

guard.tip: Steps in for a hurt friend and keeps by the leader.

hold.tip: Keeps this ground and fights what comes into reach.

formations._comment: Formations (D289, D305; all Inferred). The player's party walks and fights in a shape: the lead at the origin, each companion in a slot, `at` [across (the lead's right is positive), forward (ahead is positive)], in a `line` (front, flank, back). Companions are dealt slots by what they fight with (line_by_doctrine by a lead's tactics doctrine, else read from their abilities: a mender or a shooter is back, one who swings up close front, the rest flank): the back line is dealt first, then the front, then the rest, each to the nearest line it would rather stand in, from the first as many slots as there are companions (a shape's slots are written in the order they fill, so a small party keeps a compact shape with no holes). The player picks a shape on the party screen; `auto` picks by how many walk (auto_by_size, the lead counted; fallback below the smallest written). On the ground the followers walk to their slots, ground_spacing pixels a slot, and fall back to the trail where a slot cannot be stood on. In a fight the party falls in round the lead (the `form` move, every form_every seconds) until anyone of it is in contact with a foe; a companion standing within slack of its slot gets hold_guard off every blow, the Formation aura's idea as the bonus for holding one. Enemies and allies keep to their own ways.
formations.auto_tip: The party picks a shape by how many walk: two abreast, three in a wedge, four in a diamond, six in a pyramid.
formations._comment_foes: D289, D315 (piece E's last; Inferred). A band of foes falls in too: from foes.from of them standing, round its caller (its boss, else the first of them standing, D306), in the shape auto_by_size picks for its size, each dealt a slot by what it fights with (line_of), the shape facing the nearest of the party; a foe walks to its slot (the form move, form_every) while none of the band is in contact with the party, and is spared foes.hold_guard of every blow for holding it (none). On the ground too (D320, foes.ground): a band of foes.from or more figures patrols and travels in the same shape round the one in front, ground_spacing pixels a slot, each figure falling back to the trail where its slot cannot be stood on.
formations._comment_leader: D289, D306 (piece E2; all Inferred). A natural leader comes out of the fights: the party member with the most fights won (from_won or more), unless one within charisma_lift wins of them has more Charisma (D334, call BW: Charisma breaks a tie and lifts someone up to two wins behind; then fights won, the higher level, the marching order), who need not be the lead you play. They recommend a shape (shapes_by_line, by the line they fight in) which Auto takes; the player may pick another. In a fight the leader (else the lead) calls out when they go for a soft foe (callouts: healer for a mender, archer for a shooter), once per foe, a word both sides hear: the foe called is warned for warned_for seconds, tries warned_first moves first and its friends guard it; a foe's boss calls the same on the party, and the one called is warned the same way. A companion whose mood is under break_below_mood does not fall in and holds no slot (a formation breaking on mood). A bonus for fights shared: a party fighter is spared shared.per_fight of every blow, and lands as much more, for every fight won beside the others present (their average), up to shared.cap.

callouts._comment_orders: D335: a call from the party's natural leader is an order: everyone of the party standing within order_reach cells of the one called, with no order of the player's, not told to hold and not broken, turns on it for answer_for seconds while it stands (answered says so in the log).

formations._comment_trust: D335 (D289: 'a formation can break ... through moods and trust'): a companion whose bond with whoever calls the shape (the leader, else the lead) is break_below_bond or under holds no slot, on the ground or in a fight.

wedge.tip: The lead at the point, blades at each shoulder, the mender inside the V.

pyramid.tip: One, two and three: the lead, two blades behind, a row of three behind them.

janus.description: For every foe standing more than his own side, his skills come back 25% faster, up to twice as fast.

bellona.description: Every 10 seconds in a fight she calls Advance (allies within 3 tiles move 35% faster) or Break Them (they deal 20% more), for 5 seconds. Allies within 2 tiles get their energy back half again as fast.

cassius.description: Each hit he takes teaches him the one who dealt it: he deals 6% more to them, up to 30%, for the rest of the fight.

saturn.description: Foes within 1 tile of him move 40% slower.

vesta.description: Every 12 seconds she wards the most hurt ally within 3 tiles: the next 15% of their health in damage is turned aside. Her blows burn the dead for 50% more, and only the dead are left burning.

caesar.description: Takes a quarter of every blow meant for an ally beside him. Once a fight, when he goes down, he gets back up after 3 seconds.

iris.description: Her hits mark a foe for 8 seconds, and the party deals 10% more to it. Finishing a marked foe herself makes her deal 10% more for the rest of the fight, up to 30%.

pluto.description: What he kills gets up again and fights for him, at 40% of its health, two at a time. Each kind he has killed this fight makes him deal 5% more, up to 25%.

ceres.description: Standing still for 2.5 seconds, she plants the ground. Allies within 1 tile of a planting recover 1.5% of their health every second; foes there move half as fast. On her own planting she deals 15% more.

cato.description: After 2 seconds without moving he is set: he takes 15% less and deals 10% more, and takes another 10% less with an ally beside him.

juno.description: Every draught and herb mends twice as much for her. Every 8 seconds she throws one from the pouch to an ally within 4 tiles under 45% health, and it mends twice as much for them too.

ultor.description: Every hit on the same foe deals 6% more than the last, up to 30%. Turning to another foe starts again.

diana.description: Her wolf fights beside her at her level. While it is down she deals 40% less.

ares.description: For the first 10 seconds of a fight he deals 35% more and swings 25% faster. After that he tires: 10% less, and 15% slower.

liber.description: Cannot be stunned. Deals 2% more for every 5 seconds of the fight, up to 30%.

brawler.description: Walks up to the nearest foe and swings.

charger.description: Rushes in from three or more tiles away at a sprint, and the first blow of a charge lands 40% harder.

kiter.description: Shoots from range and backs off when someone closes in.

healer.description: Hangs back and patches up its own side before it is badly hurt.

craven.description: Fights while it is winning; badly hurt, it breaks and runs, and turns only when cornered.

_comment_by_tier: D275: what each tier of a monster (D262) brings beside its family's own passives and role. The lesser runs when hurt, the high charges and goes for the flank, the hob fights harder near death, the chieftain spurs its kin, the top's caster finds the weak spot. A row's passives add to the family's; its role stands in for the family's unless role_by_template names one.
_comment_family_tricks: D276: each monster family's own trick, carried by its tiers from the hob up (`from`), beside its tier's way of fighting (by_tier): goblins' spite when one of theirs falls, the wolves' howl, the slime oozing back, the tree's bark, and so on.

conditions._comment: What a move leaves on whoever it lands on, and how it shows (D192). An ability names a condition and its size: knockback and pull in tiles, the rest in seconds (stun stays the ability's own key). Every one is seen on the body it lands on: a slide, a frost, flames, drips of blood, a body laid flat, a cracked guard, a word over the head. resists says who shrugs one off; that shows too, as its resist word in silver. All of it Inferred (agenda row 123).

knockdown.tip: Knocks the target flat for %.1fs; breaks a cast

resists._comment: boss: a keeper or chief is never moved or laid flat. heavy: a body this big or bigger is shoved one tile less (so a one-tile shove reads Unmoved). by_style: a lead's signature. by_template: what a creature is made of.
